records.jp: くっ……こんな！
records.en_auxiliary: Ghh... No!

records.jp: ヒナちゃん、一回下がろう！　ダメージが大きすぎる！
records.en_original: Hina, we need to retreat! We've taken too much damage!
records.en_auxiliary: Hina, we need to retreat! We've taken too much damage!
records.en: Hina-chan, we need to retreat! We've taken too much damage!

records.jp: でも私達が逃げ出したら学校が！
records.en_original: But if we run away, the school will be...!
records.en_auxiliary: But if we run away, the school will be...!
records.en: But if we run away, the school will be...!

records.jp: また来る！
records.en_auxiliary: Here it comes again!

records.jp: っ！
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh!
M-Mao?!

records.jp: ……人の縄張りで好き勝手してくれて。ここは私の学校よ？<CR>いったい誰の許可を得て暴れ回ってるの
records.en_original: ...Who do you think you are, messing around on my turf? This is my school! You can't go on a rampage without permission!
records.en_auxiliary: ...Who do you think you are, messing around on my turf? This is my school! You can't go on a rampage without permission!
records.en: ...Who do you think you are, messing around on my turf? This is my school! You can't go on a rampage without permission!

records.jp: 『失せろ！』
records.en_auxiliary: Now get lost!

records.jp: 人は愚かで、身勝手で、そして弱い。<CR>だからこそ私が見守り、導いていく必要がある
records.en_original: People are foolish, selfish, and weak. And that's why I need to protect and guide them.
records.en_auxiliary: People are foolish, selfish, and weak. And that's why I need to protect and guide them.
records.en: People are foolish, selfish, and weak. And that's why I need to protect and guide them.

records.jp: 過ちは防ぎ、欲望はさばき、罪には応報する
records.en_original: To prevent their mistakes, to mediate their selfish desires, and to punish evil.
records.en_auxiliary: To prevent their mistakes, to mediate their selfish desires, and to punish evil.
records.en: To prevent their mistakes, to mediate their selfish desires, and to punish evil.

records.jp: 綺麗なものも汚いものも全部まとめて、受け入れると決めた。<CR>だからこの場所は壊させない！　私がすべて守ってみせる！
records.en_original: I've decided to accept it all, the beautiful and the ugly. So I won't let you destroy this place! I will protect it!
records.en_auxiliary: I've decided to accept it all—the beautiful and the ugly. So I won't let you destroy this place! I will protect it!
records.en: I've decided to accept it all, the beautiful and the ugly. So I won't let you destroy this place! I will protect it!

records.jp: フラグメント！？　なんで！
records.en_auxiliary: Her Fragment?! Why?

records.jp: ヒナちゃんの思いと共鳴している……？
records.en_original: Is it resonating with Hina's wishes...?
records.en_auxiliary: Is it resonating with Hina's wishes...?
records.en: Is it resonating with Hina-chan's wishes...?

records.jp: 麻央、私はあなたの考えを認めるつもりはない。<CR>あなたがやったことは許せないし、理解できる気もしない
records.en_original: Mao, I can't accept your way of thinking. I can't forgive what you've done, and I really don't understand it.
records.en_auxiliary: Mao, I can't accept your way of thinking. I can't forgive what you've done, and I don't think I'll ever be able to understand it.
records.en: Mao, I can't accept your way of thinking. I can't forgive what you've done, and I really don't understand it.

records.jp: でも、一つだけ、根本の部分に、<CR>同じ想いがある気がする
records.en_original: But I think, at the very bottom of our hearts, we have something in common.
records.en_auxiliary: But I think, at the very bottom of our hearts, we have something in common.
records.en: But I think, at the very bottom of our hearts, we have something in common.

records.jp: 私は、私たちの居場所を守りたい。<CR>この世界を守っていきたい！
records.en_original: We both want to protect our place in the world. We want to protect this world!
records.en_auxiliary: We both want to protect our place in the world. We want to protect this world!
records.en: We both want to protect our place in the world. We want to protect this world!

records.jp: 麻央、あなたは？
records.en_auxiliary: What do you say, Mao?

records.jp: ……聞くまでもないわ。<CR>私は私のクラスを、学校を、世界を守る
records.en_original: ...You don't even have to ask. I'm going to protect my class, my school, and my world.
records.en_auxiliary: ...You don't even have to ask. I'm going to protect my class, my school, and my world.
records.en: ...You don't even have to ask. I'm going to protect my class, my school, and my world.

records.jp: ずっとそうしてきた。これからだって同じよ
records.en_original: Just as I've been doing all along.
records.en_auxiliary: Just as I've been doing all along.
records.en: Just as I've been doing all along.

records.jp: じゃあ原種を、あいつを倒すのを手伝ってくれる？
records.en_original: So, will you help me defeat this Sephira?
records.en_auxiliary: So, will you help me defeat this Sephira?
records.en: So, will you help me defeat this Sephira?

records.jp: あなたと一緒に？　あれを？
records.en_auxiliary: That thing? With you?

records.jp: ……倒せるの？
records.en_auxiliary: ...Is that even possible?

records.jp: 麻央が力を貸してくれるなら
records.en_original: It is if you lend me your strength.
records.en_auxiliary: It is if you lend me your strength.
records.en: It is if you lend me your strength.

records.jp: いいわ。協力してあげる
records.en_auxiliary: Fine. Then I'll play along.

records.jp: 何、この感情の流れ……
records.en_auxiliary: What is this flow of emotions?

records.jp: ものすごい力が……二人の間に流れこんでる
records.en_original: It's a powerful force...pouring into the both of you.
records.en_auxiliary: There's a powerful force pouring into both of them.
records.en: It's a powerful force...pouring into the both of you.

records.jp: ライム！　指輪を！
records.en_auxiliary: Lime! The ring!

records.jp: ！　うん！
records.en_auxiliary: G-got it!

records.jp: うっ
records.en_auxiliary: Ah!

records.jp: うわっ
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa!

records.jp: きゃっ
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh!

records.jp: これは……
records.en_auxiliary: Look at this...

records.jp: 武器が、パワーアップした……
records.en_auxiliary: Our weapons powered up...

records.jp: まおちゃんの力……？　でもこんな、すごい
records.en_original: Is this Mao's power...? It's unbelievable.
records.en_auxiliary: Is this Mao's power...? It's unbelievable.
records.en: Is this Mao-chan's power...? It's unbelievable.

records.jp: 今までにない力を感じる……。<CR>この力があれば……！
records.en_original: I feel so much stronger than ever before... With strength like this...
records.en_auxiliary: I feel so much stronger than ever before... With strength like this...
records.en: I feel so much stronger than ever before... With strength like this...

records.jp: 原種を完全に倒せるかも！
records.en_original: I bet we could actually defeat this Sephira!
records.en_auxiliary: I bet we could actually defeat this Sephira!
records.en: I bet we could actually defeat this Sephira!

records.jp: うん
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure of it.

records.jp: 二人とも、行くよ！
records.en_auxiliary: Then let's go!

records.en_original: Your maximum number of Overdrives has increased due to your newly-enhanced weapons.
records.en_auxiliary: Your maximum number of Overdrives has increased due to your newly-enhanced weapons.
records.en: Your maximum number of Overdrives has increased due to your newly-enhanced weapons.
